function.arguments: {"what_broke":"Worker queue backlog is high and rising because the background worker cannot authenticate with PostgreSQL after a password rotation.","root_cause":{"culprit":"chg-9155","explanation":"Vault rotated the database password for the worker role (chg-9155 at 09:35 UTC), but the running worker pods still held the old password in memory/environment, causing continuous authentication failures and a rapidly growing queue backlog.","category":"credentials_mismatch"},"proposed_fix":{"risk":"low","summary":"Restart the worker deployment so it picks up the newly rotated database password from Vault.","commands":["kubectl rollout restart deployment/worker -n shop"],"rollback":["kubectl rollout undo deployment/worker -n shop"]},"affected_service":"worker","confidence":1,"evidence":[{"service":"worker","observation":"password authentication failed for user worker","kind":"log","ref":"2026-09-14T10:29:41Z ERROR psycopg2.OperationalError: connection to server at \"postgres\" (10.0.2.20), port 5432 failed: FATAL:  password authentication failed for user \"worker\""},{"ref":"chg-9155","service":"postgres","observation":"rotated postgres password for role worker via vault-rotator","kind":"change"},{"ref":"queue_depth","observation":"queue depth started rising sharply at 09:35 UTC immediately following chg-9155","service":"worker","kind":"metric"}]}
